All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions — the rollback was approved and completed successfully.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): Documented the health check failures from v2.3.1, the rollback action, and the post-rollback recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failures is identified.
